title: Export Potential of Singapore’s Water Recycling and Management Capabilities and Support for Water Technology Firms to Compete Globally
what_it_is: Export Potential of Singapore’s Water Recycling and Management Capabilities and Support for Water Technology Firms to Compete Globally

sections.label: Support for water-technology firms
sections.summary: Government promotes the water industry and supports Singapore-based companies like Keppel and Sembcorp pursuing overseas opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (a) whether existing financing and risk-sharing mechanisms are sufficient for Singapore-based water-technology firms to compete internationally with state-backed competitors in large-scale overseas projects; and (b) whether further enhancements are planned to strengthen Singapore’s global competitiveness and support local firms in securing international desalination and recycling contracts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Therefore, the Government has been promoting the water industry and investing in the research and development (R&D) of water technologies under Research, Innovation and Enterprise (RIE).

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Enterprise Singapore, PUB and the Singapore Water Association work together to support Singapore-based companies such as Keppel and Sembcorp as they build capabilities and pursue opportunities overseas.

sections.label: Grants for watertech companies
sections.summary: Watertech companies like Hydroleap and SG Enviro can tap the Enterprise Development Grant and Market Readiness Assistance grant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Watertech companies like Hydroleap and SG Enviro have and can tap the Enterprise Development Grant to upgrade, innovate and access new markets and our Market Readiness Assistance grant to defray the costs of overseas market promotion.

sections.label: EFS risk sharing
sections.summary: Under EFS, Government offers risk sharing with participating Financial Institutions, such as for fixed asset loans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Under EFS, Government offers risk sharing with participating Financial Institutions, such as for fixed asset loans for construction or the acquisition of plants and equipment.

sections.label: No plans for export office
sections.summary: There are no immediate plans regarding the circular economy export office and the market integrated cooling solutions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: With regard to the circular economy export office and the market integrated cooling solutions, there are no immediate plans to do so.

sections.label: Water tech investment outcomes
sections.summary: Since 2006, Government invested about $800 million from RIE on water tech, growing from 50 to about 400 companies and over 20,000 jobs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Since 2006, Government has invested about $800 million from RIE on water tech.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In fact, we have now moved from 50 to about 400 companies and increased job opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, now, it is about over 20,000 jobs.
